access_links.label: Annual average methane concentration 2016 raster data

description: Global - Annual Average Methane Concentration is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Climate, Environment", published or maintained by Smriti Kumble (World Bank Group). This raster maps average atmospheric methane concentrations in 2016. The data used to create it is from the NASA Aqua satellite (specifically the AIRS instrument) that records monthly average atmospheric methane concentrations. AIRS collects methane data at different pressure levels. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 1 file in GeoTIFF. The portal files it under Climate, Environment. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
